In every genus-one rotation of this exterior, each facial walk
containing $a,b,d$ has attachment sequence $abad$, up to cyclic
shift and reversal~\supp{R7}.
Corollary~\ref{cor:boundary-completions} therefore requires
$B_1+ab+ad$ to be planar. It is not, so the retained graph is
nontoroidal and minimality forces it to equal $G$.
Keep a $K_{3,3}$ subdivision of $B_1+ab+ad$ and apply
Lemma~\ref{core:retained-subdivision}. The reduction keeps
the three attachments, connected interior and the failed test,
so minimality also leaves $B_1$ unchanged.
Construction~\ref{common:marked-construction} gives $349$
possibilities for $B_1$. Every resulting graph has a $K_5$ minor,
a cut of at most two vertices or a proper nontoroidal minor~\supp{E28}.
